subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the face having '6'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46151e9675a1b248293de5a434fbe384578eb87e18759eb330513a8f3d6d969b.png]
solution:
The given dice 1 and dice 2 is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/493a3ed23f96eb0ef09ca96daa090f8c7c516fe5ebd640113247ef71ecca575c.png] 

The six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6.

From dice 1 and dice 2, '5' is adjacent of 1, 2, 3, 4.

So, the 5 will be opposite face '6'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"5".**
